clues: This city in the northeast of the United States sits on the east bank of a big river. Three smaller rivers join that river near here.
Summer storms here can grow fast when hot, wet air runs into cold air moving in. In winter, strong storms can drop deep snow on this river valley.
This place was founded in 1636, the first town with its name in the New World. George Washington later picked it for a big gun works.
In 1891, a man from Canada made up a brand new game in this city. That game was basketball.
The old gun works here is now a park site with a huge show of old guns. It holds the largest set of old American guns in the world.
